title: Google now offers free SAT practice exams, powered by Gemini

Gemini then analyzes the results, highlighting strengths and identifying areas that need further review. It also offers detailed explanations for any incorrect answers.

summary: Madhu Gottumukkala said the Trump administration supports a long-term renewal of the 2015 Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Act. The agency is also working on finalizing regulation under the Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act.

title: Massachusetts can make ‘bottom-up’ distribution reforms for a better grid
summary: Adopting a distribution system operator, or DSO, structure would make the grid cleaner, more flexible and more affordable, writes Corrin Moss of the Massachusetts Clean Energy Center.

title: Gas sector takes furnace efficiency fight to Supreme Court
summary: Advocates say stricter efficiency rules can be met with proven, energy-saving technologies. The gas industry says the rules ban non-condensing furnaces and other products.

title: PJM cost concerns bleed into transmission planning
summary: A proposed $1.7-billion, 765-kV power line across central Pennsylvania by NextEra Energy and Exelon could become the “poster child” for overbuilding new transmission infrastructure, according to that state’s ratepayer advocate.

title: Managed EV charging can save utilities and ratepayers money: report
summary: By optimizing electric vehicle charging around peak times, utilities can delay costly distribution grid upgrades while cutting per-vehicle charging costs by 25% or more, Brattle Group said this month.

title: Project finance is the missing link for the nuclear buildout we need
summary: This model fuels nearly every major energy infrastructure investment and should be applied to nuclear, too, writes Ruhani Arya of Bank of America.

title: Labor, tariffs collide with data center boom
summary: Contractors report booming demand for certain types of builds, particularly data centers and power projects to support them. But outside those sectors, workforce shortages and tariffs weigh on construction.

title: New Jersey governor orders state to accelerate solar, storage and virtual power plants
summary: Gov. Mikie Sherrill, who was sworn in Tuesday, also ordered regulators to study how to “modernize” the traditional electric utility business model, including by making utility profits “less dependent on capital spending.”

title: Google sees CO2 batteries as large-scale way to store renewable energy
summary: The tech giant is working with a Milan-based company called Energy Dome, which has built a model facility in Ottana, Sardinia, Italy. As part of the partnership, Google has made an equity investment in the company.

title: Argentina and Brazil MoU on maritime nuclear regulation
summary: Argentina's Nuclear Regulatory Authority and Brazil's Naval Secretariat for Nuclear Safety and Quality aim to develop regulation relating to the use of nuclear reactors on ships.

title: First mobile sorption unit launched by Rosatom
summary: The construction and installation of the first mobile sorption unit at the Verkhne-Uksyanskaya deposit of the Dalmatovskoye uranium deposit is aimed at ensuring optimised uranium production, Rosatom says.

title: Bulk sample programme begins at Tony M mine
summary: The programme will see the extraction of up to 2000 tons of mineralised material to generate real-world mining, processing, and cost data, and is a "decision gate" towards a potential restart decision for IsoEnergy's past-producing uranium mine.

title: Chinese tokamak achieves progress in high-density operation
summary: Experiments at China's Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak have confirmed the existence of "a density-free region" of the tokamak, finding a method to break through the density limit and providing important physical evidence for the high-density operation of magnetic confinement fusion devices.

title: Muroosystems expands nuclear cooperation in Central Asia
summary: Japan's Muroosystems Corporation has signed a memorandum of understanding with UzAtom, Uzbekistan's nuclear development agency, for cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy. The focus of this cooperation is on nuclear safety, regulatory support, technical consulting, and owner's engineering services for nuclear projects.

title: Slovakia selects Rothschild & Co to advise on new nuclear financing
summary: The Slovak Republic has chosen Rothschild & Co after a competitive selection process for a financial advisor for its proposed new nuclear project.

title: Meta announces 'landmark' agreements for new nuclear
summary: Tech giant Meta says new agreements with Vistra, TerraPower, and Oklo will support up to 6.6 GW of new and existing capacity by 2035 and, together with last year's agreement with Constellation Energy, make it one of the most significant corporate purchasers of nuclear energy in US history.

title: Akkuyu 2's turbine generator stator installed
summary: The 437-tonne turbine generator stator was moved on a special track before being lifted into place in the turbine hall of unit 2 at Turkey's Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant.

title: In pictures: Second Hinkley Point C reactor vessel delivered to site
summary: The Hinkley Point C nuclear power plant project in Somerset, England, has taken delivery of the reactor pressure vessel for its second EPR unit.

title: Nuclear at heart of Kazakh plans says president
summary: Nuclear energy is at the heart of Kazakhstan's strategic plans as it transitions to become a "digital power", the country's president has said in an interview with a national newspaper. Separately, the USA and Kazakhstan announced an expansion of their civil nuclear energy partnership with the launch of an SMR feasibility study.

title: Agreements for potential deployment of NANO microreactors
summary: US energy infrastructure solutions provider Ameresco Inc has signed a memorandum of understanding with NANO Nuclear Energy Inc to explore the potential deployment of micromodular reactors on federal and commercial sites. Meanwhile, DS Danseok has signed an MoU with NANO for the deployment of its microreactors in South Korea.

title: US enrichment funding recipients flesh out plans
summary: The companies selected to receive nearly USD3 billion in federal funding to strengthen US uranium enrichment services over the next decade have set out details of how and where they intend to deploy the funding, which will support thousands of jobs as well as building the domestic nuclear supply chain.

title: Zeeland study looks at potential for SMRs
summary: Small modular reactors could complement offshore wind and proposed large-scale nuclear power units in the Netherlands, a study commissioned by the Province of Zeeland says.

title: Hinkley Point B plant declared free of fuel
summary: The UK's Office for Nuclear Regulation has granted the Hinkley Point B nuclear power plant in Somerset Fuel Free Verification status, confirming all nuclear fuel has been removed on time and on budget and allowing the plant to move into its decommissioning phase.

title: Fortum deepens cooperation with Steady Energy
summary: Finnish utility Fortum has signed a framework agreement with small modular reactor developer Steady Energy under which Fortum will support Steady Energy in planning its district heating reactor's operation and maintenance model. In addition, Fortum will invest in Steady Energy.

title: Operating permit for very low-level waste disposal facility in Finland
summary: An operating permit which is valid until 2095 has been issued by the Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority of Finland for a new disposal facility for very low-level radioactive waste at Olkiluoto, to be operated by Teollisuuden Voima Oyj.

title: Impact assessment process begins for Canadian new-build
summary: Ontario Power Generation has submitted the Initial Project Description for a new nuclear plant at Wesleyville near Port Hope, a regulatory milestone marking the first step in the impact assessment process.

title: Helen creating subsidiary for nuclear project
summary: Finnish energy firm Helen is establishing a wholly-owned subsidiary, Helen Ydinvoima Oy, to investigate the prerequisites for constructing nuclear power in Helsinki and to prepare the project for an investment decision.

title: Arabelle turbines selected for Polish plant
summary: EDF subsidiary Arabelle Solutions has been selected by Bechtel and Westinghouse to supply half-speed Arabelle steam turbine and generator sets for the three AP1000 units planned at Poland's first nuclear power plant.

title: Tests confirm integrity of Deep Isolation disposal canister
summary: US nuclear waste disposal company Deep Isolation says that a two-year research project that subjected its Universal Canister System to the kinds of conditions found thousands of feet below the surface has shown materials used in its fabrication perform reliably and remain resistant to corrosion over time.
